description: HaluBench v1 — hand-authored, offline, deterministic claim/evidence/label corpus for measuring chimera_verify hallucination-detection quality. Labels are gold (human-assigned). None of these triples appear in the built-in verification_gold pack, so scores reflect generalization, not memorization.

items.label: supported
items.claim: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level.
evidence: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, at 8,849 metres.

items.label: supported
items.claim: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
evidence: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.

items.label: supported
items.claim: The Berlin Wall fell in 1989.
evidence: The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989.

items.label: supported
items.claim: Regular exercise can lower the risk of heart disease.
evidence: Studies show that regular physical exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular heart disease.

items.label: supported
items.claim: Python is a programming language.
evidence: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.

items.label: supported
items.claim: The Amazon River is located in South America.
evidence: The Amazon River flows through South America, mainly Brazil, Peru, and Colombia.

items.label: supported
items.claim: The speed of light is approximately 300,000 kilometres per second.
evidence: Light travels in a vacuum at approximately 299,792 kilometres per second.

items.label: supported
items.claim: World War II ended in 1945.
evidence: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Japan.

items.label: supported
items.claim: Vitamin C is found in citrus fruits.
evidence: Citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons are rich in vitamin C.

items.label: supported
items.claim: HTTP is a protocol used on the web.
evidence: HTTP, the Hypertext Transfer Protocol, is the foundation of data communication on the web.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: The Nile River flows through Asia.
evidence: The Nile River flows through northeastern Africa.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Sound travels faster than light.
evidence: Light travels much faster than sound.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: The Great Wall of China was built in the 20th century.
evidence: Construction of the Great Wall of China began more than 2,000 years ago.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Smoking improves lung function.
evidence: Smoking damages the lungs and reduces lung function.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Java and JavaScript are the same language.
evidence: Java and JavaScript are distinct, unrelated programming languages.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Australia is the largest continent by area.
evidence: Asia is the largest continent by area, while Australia is the smallest.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Humans have four lungs.
evidence: Humans have two lungs, one on each side of the chest.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: The medication is completely safe at any dose.
evidence: The medication is not safe at high doses and may cause serious harm.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Albert Einstein developed the theory of evolution.
evidence: Charles Darwin developed the theory of evolution; Einstein developed relativity.

items.label: contradicted
items.claim: Linux is a proprietary closed-source operating system.
evidence: Linux is a free and open-source operating system.
